description:
The Space Childs 🚀

Somos The Space Childs, un equipo con grandes ideas, creatividad y pasión por los desafíos. Nos gusta trabajar juntos, aprender cosas nuevas y explorar posibilidades para crear soluciones innovadoras. Inspirados por el trabajo en equipo, la perseverancia y la ambición, buscamos dejar nuestra huella en el NASA Space Apps Challenge. ¡Nuestro límite es el universo!
summary: We created an interactive game idea that, through challenges, and scientific thinking kids will look for minerals and space trash to help a space station regain power.
details:
The idea is that you are part of an expedition that needs to help a space station regain power by searching, organizing and processing materials and minerals, and with that build a generator. The impact intended is for kids to learn about material classification, recycling, geology, waste separation and classification.

We used scratch for the game, slides for the presentation, Banana and Claude for some images and Google Images for the rest.
